pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED (PostgreSQL + watchdog recent_closed, meta_rsi from _signal_metadata, last 20 closes):

1) PUMP-CHAIN- SHORTS ENTERED POST-FLUSH (RSI 42-43) — n=2, 0 wins, net -0.13: FIL -0.05 (RSI 42.15), DOT -0.08 (RSI 43.48). Winning side: the LONG bounce that followed — doji-bottom caught DOGE/XPL/GMT/ONDO in the same window. Why we weren't on it: pump-chain- fired the short after the dump was complete, i.e., the signal arrived when the winning move was already 80% done. PUMP_CHAIN_SHORT_RSI_MIN=45 exists to block exactly this band; these got through on fire-time drift. Same bug class as the v2 filter drift. Steer: pre-fire guard requiring RSI>=45 at EXECUTION time for pump-chain- (audit-only 24h before enforce) — already flagged last cycle, no enforcement yet.

2) BB-BOUNCE/FRESH LONGS DURING BEAR CONTINUUM — n=4 (APT -0.09 RSI 53.7, ALT -0.11 RSI 55.6, ETC -0.04 RSI 50.0, WCT doji RSI 27.78 -0.13), 1 win, net -0.37. Winning side: SHORT continuation the continuum was already signaling (volume-buildup- ETH/POL won same window). WCT at RSI 27.78 is the BANANA mirror — longing extreme oversold = catching the falling knife. Do NOT disable bb-bounce (brain auditor tunes params); the fix is holding fresh LONGs until continuum flips ABOVE EMA300. Shadow-audit candidate: block doji-bottom LONG below RSI 35 (n=1, too early to enforce).

3) YGG DOJI-BOTTOM AT RSI 48.78 — n=1, -0.24 (-3.2%), the single biggest wrong-side loss this session. Center-band RSI looked fine; the flush-reversal simply never came because the 15m trend was already SHORT_BIAS. Winning side: staying flat or SHORT. This is the only true 'wrong direction' loss in the 20; the rest were late entries on the correct family.

WINNERS to lean into: volume-buildup- SHORT continuation (2/2 this session, 87.5% WR n=8 historically); doji-bottom LONG flush-reversals ONLY at RSI 45-60 with continuum confirmation; ai-trader manual (60% WR) — the BTC short currently open is this family.
